entities.name: Photosystem II PsbI
observations: The 38-aa query exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q0P3J5 from Ostreococcus tauri; annotated as photosystem II reaction center protein I.
Query has Pfam PsbI domain PF02532.20 at residues 1–36; reference is localized to the chloroplast thylakoid membrane as a single-pass membrane protein.
Sequence-derived estimates: 4,357.031 Da, pI 6.028, GRAVY 0.5342; these assume unmodified protein.
